results.question: which meetup spot got the most new listings in spring 2026?
results.sql:
SELECT ms.name AS meetup_spot,
       COUNT(*) AS new_listings
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.calendar c ON la.listed_on = c.day
JOIN nlq.meetup_spots ms ON la.spot_id = ms.spot_id
WHERE c.semester = 'Spring'
  AND c.academic_year = '2025-26'
GROUP BY ms.name
ORDER BY new_listings DESC
LIMIT 1;

results.question: what share of all listings ever posted were offered for rent?

  COUNT(*) AS total_listings,

FROM nlq.listings_all;

results.question: for each category, how many days on average does it take an item to sell?

SELECT la.category,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM d.completed_at - la.listed_at) / 86400), 2) AS avg_days_to_sell
FROM nlq.deals d
JOIN nlq.listings_all la ON d.item_id = la.item_id
WHERE d.deal_type = 'sale'
  AND d.status = 'completed'
  AND d.completed_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY la.category
ORDER BY la.category;
results.answer: Across the nine categories, the average days to sell are: bikes_transport 11.20 days, clothing 11.32 days, dorm_essentials 11.39 days, electronics 11.40 days, furniture 11.61 days, kitchen 11.49 days, other 12.08 days, sports_outdoors 11.56 days, textbooks 11.56 days.

results.question: average rating buyers give sellers, by item category
results.sql:
SELECT c.category,
       c.label,
       ROUND(AVG(r.rating)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating
FROM nlq.reviews r
JOIN nlq.deals d ON r.deal_id = d.deal_id
JOIN nlq.listings_all l ON d.item_id = l.item_id
JOIN nlq.categories c ON l.category = c.category
WHERE r.reviewer_role = 'buyer'
GROUP BY c.category, c.label
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC;

results.question: what share of conversations led to a request, by meetup spot?

results.question: late-return rate for rentals due during finals compared with rentals due during regular classes
results.sql:
SELECT
  calendar.period,
  COUNT(*) AS total_returned,
  SUM(CASE WHEN deals.returned_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_returns,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN deals.returned_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS late_return_rate_percent
FROM nlq.deals AS deals
JOIN nlq.calendar AS calendar ON deals.rental_due_date = calendar.day
WHERE deals.deal_type = 'rental'
  AND deals.rental_returned_at IS NOT NULL
  AND calendar.period IN ('finals', 'classes')
GROUP BY calendar.period;
results.answer: For rentals due during regular classes, the late‑return rate was 19.73% (541 late returns out of 2,742). For rentals due during finals, the rate was 18.66% (25 late returns out of 134).

results.question: which category has the highest sell-through rate?
results.sql:
SELECT c.category,
       c.label,
       COUNT(*) AS total_listings,
       SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'sold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sold_count,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'sold' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS sell_through_percent
FROM nlq.listings_all la
JOIN nlq.categories c ON la.category = c.category
GROUP BY c.category, c.label
ORDER BY sell_through_percent DESC
LIMIT 1;
results.answer: The Dorm essentials category (dorm_essentials) has the highest sell‑through rate at 61.73%. It had 1,620 listings and 1,000 of them sold.
